shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,240p' app/ProductGallery.tsx && printf '\\n--- nearby files ---\\n' && rg --files app | sort | sed -n '1,160p' && printf '\\n--- package ---\\n' && cat package.json"

/bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,220p' app/page.tsx && printf '\\n--- layout ---\\n' && sed -n '1,220p' app/layout.tsx && printf '\\n--- image usage ---\\n' && rg -n 'next/image|<Image|<img|imageUrl|width=|height=' . -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"'"
